# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.33

Live RX Phones CRM context candidate dated 2026-07-26.

## Administrator presence context

- RX Tracker-originated calls show the patient name, patient ID, clinic, and
  dialed number on the Administrator-only **Live RX Phones** board.
- Active calls are labeled **RX Tracker call** and retained terminal snapshots
  are labeled **Last RX Tracker call**.
- Patient name, patient ID, clinic, and number are searchable on the board.
- Manually dialed softphone calls continue to show phone-only information
  because they have no RX Tracker patient association.

## Privacy boundary

- The presence board remains Administrator-only and view-only.
- Patient context is resolved from the existing call-attempt correlation ID.
- Date of birth, address, notes, SIP passwords, and other patient information
  are not included.

## Safety

- No database migration or business-data rewrite.
- No call-placement, relay-polling, proxy, origin, port, PBX, or RX Softphone
  change.

## Validation

- Managed-relay regression covers patient correlation and bounded response
  fields.
- Browser integration regression covers CRM rendering and patient search.
